history.content: hi. not really sure how this works tbh. someone told me to try it
Hey, that’s completely fine — we can just talk normally. What’s bringing you here today?
idk. work stuff i guess. or family. its been a weird couple weeks. cant really turn my brain off at night
That sounds like a lot is still moving around in your head at night. Is it more work, family, or the weirdness of the last couple weeks that feels loudest?
family. its my dad. he had a fall like 2 weeks ago and theyre doing scans and nobody will give me a straight answer about what theyre actually looking for
That sounds really unsettled — not knowing what they’re looking for can make it hard to rest. Does it feel more like worry, or more like being left in the dark?

both? i mean my sister keeps saying its fine its routine but shes the one whos actually there. im 4 hours away. and i keep googling stuff i shouldnt and then i cant sleep and then im useless at work the next day. honestly not sure typing at an app is gonna fix any of that

That sounds very uneasy and stuck in the not-knowing — the googling and the sleep loss seem to be part of the same loop. Does it feel more like restlessness in your body, or more like a need to keep checking?

checking probably. i look at my phone like every 20 min waiting for my sister to text. and theres this thing underneath it i dont really say out loud which is. he's getting older and i live far away on purpose kind of and if something actually happens im gonna feel like i wasnt there
That sounds like checking on the outside and something much more personal underneath — maybe guilt, or worry about what being far away means. Does “I wasn’t there” feel like the sharpest part?

yeah. that one. cause i moved away after a bad stretch with him, we didnt talk for like a year once, and we're ok now mostly but its not. warm. and now the clock might be running and i dont know if i fix that or if its even fixable and im scared i'll run out of time before i figure it out
That sounds like fear mixed with something hurt and unfinished — and the “running out of time” part feels really sharp. Do you want to stay with that, or leave it here for now?
honestly i didnt expect to say that part to a phone. um. maybe just stay a sec. i dont need it solved i think i just needed to say the time thing out loud cause i cant say it to my sister shed cry
That makes sense — saying the “time” part out loud seems to have given it a little shape. I can stay with it for a moment, or we can leave it right there.
yeah lets leave it there. i think im gonna text her and just ask to call dad tonight. small thing but. thanks. this was less weird than i thought
That feels like a small, clear landing. I’m glad it was less weird than you expected.
